artifact_reconstruction_flag.rule: the upstream distribution is bit-recomposable only when explicitly declared; an unflagged artifact remains exact hashed provenance while selected content values may still become exact reusable identities

grammar.encoding: raw artifacts retain exact digest provenance and retain octet AST content only when exact-distribution is declared; delimited selected content requires shortest-form Unicode scalar UTF-8
grammar.delimiter: one declared nonzero single-byte delimiter outside UTF-8 continuation bytes
grammar.quoting: none in v1; a delimiter or line terminator always closes a field
grammar.columns: every delimited artifact declares exact UTF-8 column identities independently of whether those identities are serialized as a header
grammar.header: a delimited artifact declares zero or one exact header record; when present its fields must byte-match the declared column identities, and when absent the first physical record is data
grammar.field_count: every record has the declared field count including empty fields
grammar.terminator: every record including the last has the one declared exact line terminator
grammar.reconstruction: recomposition from parsed fields delimiter and record terminators is byte-identical only for artifacts declaring exact-distribution; other distributions return typed reconstruction-unavailable

ast.terminal_floor: active Unicode atoms provide exact selected UTF-8 content; positions 0 through 255 provide typed raw-octet operands only for exact-distribution artifacts
ast.field: field tag plus column identity and optional nonempty value
ast.record: header or record tag plus ordered field nodes and exact terminator
ast.artifact: artifact tag name declared digest parent-artifact identity and mode plus ordered content only at the declared reconstruction boundary
ast.root: source-boundary tag plus ordered artifact nodes

closure.claims: every non-header delimited record is one source-scoped witnessed claim whose evidence outcome type is declared by the source profile; the tabular carrier never hard-codes mapping, assertion, definition, example, measurement, prediction, counterexample, or any other epistemic meaning
closure.claim_scope: the profile-declared record proposition alone enters evidence and testimony; its tag field column value terminator artifact and source-boundary AST constituents remain exact structural occurrences and cannot inherit the record's epistemic role unless another explicit recipe independently declares them as propositions
closure.outcome_type: evidence outcome type belongs to the source-profile interpretation of a record and is orthogonal to artifact media type, delimiter grammar, modality, and evidence-source provenance
closure.profile_counts: bytes records fields syntax nodes spans edges references occurrences mappings outputs and dispositions are derived from the compiled whole working set
closure.artifact_reconstruction: only artifacts explicitly marked exact-distribution are required to recompose byte-for-byte; every artifact still retains exact digest length name and source-graph provenance
closure.source_graph_identity: the profile artifact-graph fingerprint binds the exact artifact topology and codec declarations plus every authority-scoped reference and mapping rule; changing rule semantics under the pinned profile fails before plan construction
closure.selected_content_reconstruction: every admitted Unicode value is an exact reusable content composition independent of whether the enclosing upstream distribution is reconstructable
closure.reference_disposition: reference-marked field occurrences remain explicitly unresolved after generic structural admission until a typed authority-release-namespace Highway topology operation resolves or rejects each endpoint; parsing a join-key-shaped string is not reference resolution
closure.curated_projection_reconstruction: the source profile separately declares exact semantic or no reconstruction for the curated witnessed projection; semantic extraction cannot borrow the artifact codec's exactness claim
closure.reference_mapping: profile-declared mapping rules pair two reference-marked columns in the same record with one typed directed or symmetric relation; the generic plan emits witnessed mapping occurrences and the product route resolves them through the shared reference-mapping ISA and transactional PostgreSQL lifecycle
